title: Makeup Museum — Content & Inventory System Modernization
role: UX & Product Design (platform re-architecture + branding refresh)
goal: Unify CMS, inventory, and storytelling to support exhibits and e-commerce expansion.
summary: Object-based content model, reusable templates, editorial workflow (roles/permissions, publish gates), asset standards, and brand refinements.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: Defined object model; IA; editorial workflow with publish gates; asset standards; brand refresh to support commerce.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body: • Client acquisition, scope/budget/timeline; technical feasibility and stack choices.\n• IA and inventory design; design quality control; design + build supervision.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body: Faster story assembly from collection objects, fewer publishing errors, brand-consistent pages, commerce-ready.
